subject: SOC 2 / SIG evidence onboarding — IR playbook, risk acceptance, and escalation plan
messages:
From: Alyssa Moreno <alyssa@finsecure.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: payments-ops@finsecure.com
Date: 2026-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 / SIG evidence + incident readout

Hi Vivek,

We saw a short authentication anomaly last week that affected a subset of token refreshes in our integration. Our security team is doing a quick internal review and has requested the following from Redwood to close our SIG / SOC 2 evidence gap: your incident response playbook (IRP) relevant to authentication incidents, a timeline of actions taken for the event, and any sanitized logs or artifacts you can share for triage.

Can you confirm what you can provide under our existing NDA, and whether you can share an IR readout + artifacts within 72 hours? We may need privileged access to a limited subset of logs for 48–72 hours to validate the root cause.

Thanks — we can turn this into a formal evidence request if needed.

— Alyssa Moreno
Sr. Security Engineer, FinSecure
alyssa@finsecure.com

Attachment: none
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Moreno <alyssa@finsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 / SIG evidence + incident readout

Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and the clear ask. We take this seriously.

Short answers up front:
- We can provide an incident readout and our IR playbook section that covers authentication and token handling.
- We will provide sanitized telemetry and a short timeline within 48 hours; full logs (sanitized) available within 72 hours.
- We can grant temporary, read-only, time-limited access to a sanitized log bundle for your security team; we will require a short access agreement (DocuSign) and an approved scope.

I’m attaching our IR playbook excerpt and a draft evidence checklist so we can align on scope. Marissa, Karthik, Neha — can you validate the attached items and call out anything else FinSecure will likely request (SIG mappings, CAIQ crosswalk, control evidence pointers)? Marissa — can you prepare the SIG evidence index and a candidate sanitized log bundle?

Plan:
1) Today — confirm scope and DocuSign access request.
2) +48h — sanitized readout + IR timeline + interim artifacts.
3) +72h — full sanitized evidence bundle.

I’ll treat this as an elevated request and escalate internally if we hit blockers.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachment: IR_Playbook_v0.9.pdf; IR_Evidence_Handoff_Checklist.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Alyssa Moreno <alyssa@finsecure.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 / SIG evidence + incident readout

Vivek / team — attaching the SIG evidence index and a short evidence mapping for authentication controls. Key notes:
- SIG rows S-AUTH-01 / S-AUTH-03 map to our token refresh controls; see column "artifact_path" in the CSV.
- For immediate triage: I will prepare a sanitized network timeline (pcap-derived events redacted), and an auth event export (JSONL) with PII hashed.
- Retention note: non-prod debug logs are kept for 7 days — for this request we can provide the 7-day window containing the event. Production request will require an approved retention exception if older than 30 days.

Proposed risk acceptance (to close FinSecure's immediate ask): temporary read-only access to sanitized logs for 72 hours, access SLA for log removal after validation, and an access attestation signed by FinSecure. If Finance requires billing for dedicated log extraction effort, we’ll flag it.

I’ve attached: SIG_evidence_index.csv (mapping), and a short checklist. Karthik — can you confirm any changes required to the export process for the JSONL?

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Security Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: SIG_evidence_index.csv; IR_Evidence_Handoff_Checklist.xlsx
From: Alyssa Moreno <alyssa@finsecure.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: payments-ops@finsecure.com
Date: 2026-08-22T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 / SIG evidence + incident readout

Thanks Marissa / Vivek — this is helpful. A few follow-ups:
- Confirmed: FinSecure will sign the access attestation. Please send the DocuSign envelope and the scope of the access (exact paths and time window).
- Can you provide the interim readout + timeline by EOD tomorrow (Aug 23)? We will escalate internally if we don’t have something by then.
- For the sanitized logs: we prefer an S3/secure link with temporary credentials rather than direct access to your infra. If you can provide a signed URL that expires after 72 hours, that works.

Also: can you include a CAIQ crosswalk for the auth-related controls so our audit team can map quickly?

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

— Alyssa
Alyssa Moreno
Sr. Security Engineer, FinSecure

Attachment: none
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Moreno <alyssa@finsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 / SIG evidence + incident readout — escalation & schedule

Alyssa / FinSecure team — finalizing scope and schedule here. Summary of decisions and next steps (actionable items):

1) Scope approved: authentication artifacts + IR timeline + CAIQ crosswalk for auth controls.
2) Access model: we will provide a signed S3 URL to a sanitized bundle (read-only) that expires after 72 hours. Requesting FinSecure to sign the access attestation (DocuSign).
3) Timeline: interim readout + IR timeline and CAIQ crosswalk — shared by 2026-08-24T17:00-07:00.
4) Evidence bundle: full sanitized package (network timeline + auth event export + SIG index) delivered by 2026-08-25T11:00-07:00 via the signed URL.

Attachments included in this message: network-timeline-logs.zip (sanitized), IR_Evidence_Handoff_Checklist.xlsx (versioned), SIG_evidence_index.csv.

Escalation note: if any required DocuSign or legal approvals are delayed beyond EOD 2026-08-24, I will escalate to VP Security for exception approval and notify FinSecure.

HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/FS-9876
DocuSign (access attestation): https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/ABC123DEF
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/ir-evidence-finsecure-2026

Thanks — we’ll keep the log bundle limited and sanitized; contact Neha for any extraction clarifications.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachments: network-timeline-logs.zip; IR_Evidence_Handoff_Checklist.xlsx; SIG_evidence_index.csv
